title: Marshall Wain Johnson (1950–2025)
content: The world lost an extraordinary entomologist and a kind, beloved friend when Marshall Wain Johnson died on 29 June 2025 in Fresno, California. A resident of nearby Clovis, he had just completed twelve wonderful years of retirement with his wife and very best friend of 45 years, Lynn LeBeck, an accomplished entomologist in her own right. Marshall was a stellar scientist and mentor who made seminal contributions to integrated pest management and biological control. He was an outstanding colleague, a talented photographer, and a passionate proponent of science and education. Walter Bentley captured the feelings of many when he said, “He was a wonderful scientist, but more importantly, a wonderful person.”
